title: Eased 20Hz-to-60fps packet motion is structurally unreachable under the committed FixedFrameRate=20 render pin
evidence: Config/DefaultEngine.ini:9-10: `bUseFixedFrameRate=True` / `FixedFrameRate=20.000000`. PPRunView.cpp:338-357: `if (Next.Tick != CurSnapshot.Tick)` { ... `if (bTopologyChanged)` { ... } `return;` } then `ElapsedSinceSnapshot += InDeltaTime;` / `// eased inter-snapshot fraction (20 Hz sim -> 60 fps view)` / `const float Frac = FMath::Clamp(ElapsedSinceSnapshot / kTickInterval, 0.0f, 1.0f);`
detail: With the render loop fixed at the sim rate, roughly one tick lands per rendered frame, so the interpolation branch runs only on no-tick frames where ElapsedSinceSnapshot already equals a full frame delta, making Frac≈1. The easing never displays; story 1.3's eased-motion criterion and checklist axis-5 cannot hold as configured.
recommended_fix: Drop or raise the engine FixedFrameRate pin (the clamped FPPSimDriver accumulator already guarantees 20Hz integer stepping regardless of display rate); keep PP::Step at 20Hz.

title: EndDraw's 'appears THIS frame' refresh is a no-op: the view only rebuilds on sim-tick change, so the drawn pipe waits for the next 20Hz step
evidence: PPRunGameMode.cpp:199-201: `// immediate refresh so the drawn pipe appears THIS frame (1.2:` / `// "two pipes are created and appear instantly")` / `BuildSnapshot();`. PPRunView.cpp:338: `if (Next.Tick != CurSnapshot.Tick)` — the world rebuild (RefreshPipes/RefreshNodes) lives only inside this branch; BuildSnapshot does not change Snapshot.Tick.
detail: EndDraw rebuilds the snapshot without stepping, so Tick is unchanged and the view's tick-change gate never fires this frame. Story 1.2's same-frame appearance criterion is delivered only accidentally, one sim step (up to 50ms) later.
recommended_fix: In NativeTick, detect TopologyGen != CurSnapshot.TopologyGen independent of the tick-change gate and rebuild the static world there; drop or justify the EndDraw BuildSnapshot call.

title: Drag-rejection feedback is claimed for the status line but never surfaced: LastEditError is read only by the test
evidence: PPRunGameMode.h:103: `// the last edit result, for the status line (rejection feedback)`. PPCommandBus.cpp:8: `// a valid pair — report MissingNode so the UI can give feedback.` PPRunView.cpp:426-427 (the only status-line write): `StatusText->SetText(FText::FromString(FString::Printf(TEXT("tick %llu  ·  packets %d  ·  score %d  ·  20 Hz"), CurSnapshot.Tick,`
detail: Rejected drags (MissingNode, self_loop, terminal_pair, span) set LastEditError/bHasLastEditError, but no view code reads them — the player gets zero feedback. Story 1.2's rejection outcomes are observable only headlessly, contradicting the documented intent.
recommended_fix: Append the LastEditError name to StatusText when bHasLastEditError is set (clearing on the next successful edit), or delete the dead 'status line' claim.

title: E4 snap radius canon says world px but SnapToNode compares the raw constant in screen px, making the effective radius viewport-dependent
evidence: PP_Balance.h:49: `inline constexpr int32_t kSnapRadius = 36;		// world px, inclusive (E4)`. PPCommandBus.cpp:31-32: `const FPPScreenFit Fit = MakeScreenFit(ViewportSize);` / `const float RadiusPx = static_cast<float>(PP::kSnapRadius);`; line 47: `if (D2 <= RadiusPx * RadiusPx && D2 < BestD2) // inclusive (E4)` where D2 is measured to `Fit.GridToScreen(...)` output.
detail: Node positions are scaled by Fit.Scale but the radius is not, so the effective world-space radius is kSnapRadius/Scale — ~39px at 1280x720 but ~20px at 2560x1440. Inclusive compare itself is correct; slice-1 node spacing never overlaps either way.
recommended_fix: Compare D2 against (kSnapRadius * Fit.Scale)^2 to honor the world-px canon, or amend the E4 comments and balance constant to declare screen px.

title: Probe flow_summary.spawned reports total demand entries, not 'demand entries fired' as SCHEMA.md defines
evidence: PPProbeCommandlet.cpp:134,137: `",\"flow_summary\":{\"spawned\":%d,\"delivered\":%d,\"live\":%d,\"score\":%d}}\n"),` ... `ReachablePairs, TotalHops, static_cast<int32>(State.Flow.Demand.size()), State.Score,`. SCHEMA.md: `| flow_summary.spawned | int | demand entries fired (packets constructed) |`. PP_Flow.h: demand entries persist: `F.Demand.push_back(FSpawnReq{Tick, Class, Src, Dst});` (never removed on firing).
detail: For -ticks below the last seeded demand tick (98), spawned over-reports: entries not yet fired are counted. The pinned golden (ticks=100) is unaffected since all 11 entries fire; only non-default probe runs drift from the schema's semantics.
recommended_fix: Count entries with SpawnTick <= State.Tick (or a fired counter in FFlowState), or reword SCHEMA.md's spawned definition to 'total seeded demand entries'.
